correctness.rationale: For a>b>d>0 sorted absolute plane-normal components, enumerating actual face vertices yields complete step functions: if c=1+s<2, N=4+2[d>sb]+2[b<sa]+2[d<sa]; if c=2+delta>2, N=4+2[a<b+delta*d]+2[b>d+delta*a]+2[b+d>delta*a][a>d+delta*b]. At c=2 the 12 cuboctahedral vertices give exactly eight crossed faces generically. Non-8 angular cones exist for every other c. On the cube side N=4 iff b+d<delta*a, six signed-axis cones; their solid angle is the stated arctangent and gives p4=(3/pi)delta²+O(delta⁴). Linearized boundaries a=b and b=d in the 48 Haar chambers have exact strip integrals 1/(2sqrt3), (1-1/sqrt3)/2, 1/sqrt3 and 1/sqrt2-1/sqrt3; multiplying by 12/pi yields all stated one-sided coefficients and the ratio sqrt2, with crossing corners O(epsilon²). Independently enumerated vertices/facets/edges of K_c for seven c values and checked 3,850 random generic section normals; all exact side counts agreed, and 100,000 directions at delta=0.4 gave p4 0.14137 vs exact 0.14160076. Numerical normals cannot prove the coarea remainder or all-c property.
